Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role
In this role, you'll combine technical expertise with a strong grasp of modern DevOps practices, leveraging CI/CD pipelines, automation, and cloud-native architectures to deliver scalable, high-quality software solutions.
Design, build and run a web application & platform based on Angular & NestJS that drives Infineon’s digitalization journey for product portfolio and roadmap management
Collaborate with other developers, architects, business analysts, UX experts and business stakeholders to design and build systems that are efficient, effective, and scalable
Work in cross-functional Scrum teams and follow DevOps practices & methods
Explore emerging trends and technologies in software development
 Your profile
 Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed
 You have great communication and collaboration skills that enable you to work effectively in cross-functional teams. Your problem-solving mindset allows you to analyze challenges, identify solutions, and drive improvements with confidence.
A university degree in computer science, informatics, or a related field (Bachelor/Master)
3+ years of hands-on experience in software development, including system integration
Proficiency in frontend development using modern frameworks (e.g. Angular, React) as well TS/JS, HTML, and CSS and experience in implementing RESTful backend services (e.g. with NestJS, Express etc.)
Strong background in relational databases like MSSQL, and knowledge of CI/CD tools like GitLab CI
Experience with cloud technologies, containerization and orchestration tools (Kubernetes, OpenShift)
Experience with agile methodologies (e.g. SCRUM, Kanban), DevOps practices (CI/CD, test automation) and version control systems (e.g. Git, Gitlab)
Fluency in English (mandatory)
